name: model_name
desc: Prefix for all output filenames. Use alphanumeric characters and underscores only.
sourceComment: Specifies the model name, which serves as the prefix for all output filenames.

name: path2output
desc: Output directory path. def_dir resolves to outputs/<model_name>/ under the working directory.
sourceComment: Defines the output directory where all generated files will be stored.

name: output_format
desc: Output format. Currently only JSON is supported.
sourceComment: Output-format selector; currently inert — snapshots are always written as JSONL.

name: simplify_npoints
desc: Target number of points retained for the simplified profile arrays in each snapshot. Clamped to ≥ 20.
sourceComment: Target number of points retained for simplified profile arrays in saved snapshots (bubble_T_arr, bubble_n_arr, bubble_dTdr_arr, bubble_v_arr, shell_grav_force_m, shell_n_arr). Default 100. Larger values give higher-fidelity snapshots at the cost of larger output files. Clamped to >= 20 (matches the coverage-skeleton chunk count). The first two simplify calls per implicit-phase snapshot log their reconstruction R² at INFO level so you can verify the chosen budget is faithful.

name: log_level
desc: Logging verbosity: DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR, CRITICAL.
sourceComment: Logging level for terminal and file output. Controls how much detail is logged. DEBUG emits per-RHS-evaluation records (formatted and written to the log file on every solver stage), a measurable hot-path cost over a full run; INFO is the default, DEBUG is opt-in for diagnostics.

name: log_console
desc: Enable terminal output for log messages.
sourceComment: Enable console (terminal) output for logging. If True, log messages are printed to terminal.

name: log_file
desc: Write log messages to {path2output}/trinity.log.
sourceComment: Enable file output for logging. If True, log messages are written to a .log file in the output directory.

name: log_colors
desc: Color-code terminal output by severity level.
sourceComment: Use colored output in terminal. If True, log messages are color-coded by severity (DEBUG=cyan, INFO=green, WARNING=yellow, ERROR=red, CRITICAL=magenta).

name: betadelta_solver
desc: Root-finder used for the energy-phase (β, δ) solve: hybr or legacy. Developer setting; leave at the default.
sourceComment: Energy-implicit (beta, delta) solver: 'hybr' (default; unbounded scipy root-finder with a physical dMdt>0 acceptance gate) or 'legacy' (bounded grid + L-BFGS-B).

name: mCloud
desc: Total mass of the molecular cloud.
notes: Cluster mass and remaining cloud mass derive from this (× sfe and × (1 − sfe)).
sourceComment: The mass of the molecular cloud.

name: sfe
desc: Star formation efficiency (0 < sfe < 1). Fraction of cloud mass converted to stars.
notes: Drives the cluster mass and the entire feedback budget; setting sfe close to 1 leaves no gas reservoir for shell expansion.
sourceComment: Star formation efficiency.

name: ZCloud
desc: Cloud metallicity. Currently only solar (1) is supported.
notes: Sets metal-line cooling, dust opacity, and stellar wind mass-loss scaling; only solar is supported in this release.
sourceComment: Cloud metallicity

name: include_PHII
desc: Include HII pressure in P_drive. When False, P_HII is set to zero.
notes: Setting to False reproduces a WARPFIELD-style driving budget without photoionised-gas pressure, useful for comparison runs.
sourceComment: Include HII pressure (from Strömgren ionization balance in shell) in P_drive. When False, P_HII is set to zero.

name: coverFraction
desc: Closed fraction of the bubble wall, Cf. Hot gas vents through the remaining open area and drains the bubble; Cf = 1 is a sealed bubble.
sourceComment: Closed fraction of the bubble wall (covering fraction Cf). Geometry-set energy/mass leak: hot gas vents through the open area (1-Cf)*4*pi*R2^2 at the interior sound speed, draining bubble energy (and, when the mass sink is enabled, mass). Cf=1 recovers the sealed (Weaver) bubble exactly; not fragmentation-triggered. Usable range ~0.9-0.99; Cf near 0 drains the bubble within a step and stresses the integrator.

name: nCore
desc: Core number density. For homogeneous clouds (densPL_alpha=0), this is the average density.
sourceComment: Hydrogen nuclei number density of cloud core (n_H). Standard GMC/ISM convention. Mass density: rho = nCore * mu_convert * m_H. If `densPL` AND densPL_alpha = 0, this is the average cloud density.

name: nISM
desc: Ambient ISM number density.
notes: Also used by the dissolution check: the shell is considered dissolved once shell_nMax stays below nISM for stop_t_diss.
sourceComment: Hydrogen nuclei number density of the ambient ISM (n_H). Mass density: rho = nISM * mu_convert * m_H.

name: rCore
desc: Core radius. Not used for homogeneous clouds.
sourceComment: Core radius of the molecular cloud.

name: rCloud_max
desc: Largest plausible cloud radius accepted by the pre-run validation. A cloud exceeding it is rejected as too diffuse for its mass.
sourceComment: Maximum plausible cloud radius used by the pre-run GMC parameter validation. If the computed rCloud exceeds this, the run is rejected as implausibly diffuse for the given mass. Increase to allow larger, more diffuse clouds.

name: dens_profile
desc: Density profile type: densPL (power-law) or densBE (Bonnor-Ebert).
notes: densPL covers the homogeneous and isothermal-sphere limits via densPL_alpha = 0 or −2; densBE is the Bonnor-Ebert isothermal sphere parameterised by Ω.
sourceComment: Specifies how the cloud density scales with radius.

name: densBE_Omega
desc: Density contrast Ω = ρ_center / ρ_edge. Values > 14.1 indicate gravitational instability.
sourceComment: if `densBE` is selected, then the ratio `Omega = nCore/nCloudEdge` must be specified.

name: densPL_alpha
desc: Power-law exponent (−2 ≤ α ≤ 0). 0 = homogeneous, −2 = isothermal sphere.
notes: α controls how steeply the density falls from the core outward; α = 0 is homogeneous and α = −2 reproduces an isothermal sphere.
sourceComment: if `densPL` is selected, then the power-law coefficient `nCore*(r/rCore)^alpha` (0 = homogeneous, -2 = isothermal) must be specified.

name: allowShellDissolution
desc: Allow shell dissolution to terminate the simulation. If False, the dissolution check is disabled.
sourceComment: Allow shell dissolution to terminate simulation. If False, shell dissolution check is disabled.

name: stop_t_diss
desc: Duration shell_nMax must remain below nISM before dissolution is triggered.
sourceComment: Duration (in Myr) that shell_nMax must remain below nISM before dissolution is triggered.

name: stop_r
desc: Maximum shell radius. Exceeding this triggers termination. Set to None to disable.
notes: Set to None to disable; the simulation then terminates only via stop_t, dissolution, or cloud-boundary conditions.
sourceComment: Maximum radial extent permitted for shell expansion. Set to None to disable this termination condition.

name: stop_t
desc: Maximum simulation duration. Set to None to disable.
notes: Set to None to let the simulation evolve until dissolution or another termination condition fires.
sourceComment: Maximum duration of the simulation. Set to None to disable this termination condition.

name: stop_at_rCloud_nSnap
desc: Terminate after the shell crosses the cloud edge. None disables; 0 stops at the edge; N > 0 lets the implicit phase advance for N more snapshots before terminating.
notes: Combines with the energy-phase reconciliation snapshot and the implicit-phase end snapshot; total post-rCloud samples is roughly N + 2.
sourceComment: Terminate simulation after the shell crosses the cloud edge (R2 > rCloud). Value is the number of post-crossing segment-loop snapshots to record before terminating. Set to None to disable. 0 stops at the edge (1a reconciliation snapshot only). N>0 lets the implicit phase advance for N more segments past the crossing — note the implicit phase's end-of-phase reconciliation snapshot adds one extra past-rCloud sample, so the total snapshots with R2 >= rCloud is roughly N + 2 (1 at-edge + N in-loop + 1 recon).

name: coll_r
desc: Radius below which the cloud is considered completely collapsed.
sourceComment: Radius below which the cloud is considered completely collapsed.

name: SB99_rotation
desc: Include stellar rotation (1=yes, 0=no). Rotation extends lifetimes via internal mixing.
notes: Rotation extends main-sequence lifetimes via internal mixing and shifts the wind/SN feedback timeline.
sourceComment: Stellar-rotation flag. Selects rot vs norot non-CIE cooling tables (trinity/cooling/non_CIE/read_cloudy.py). Only rot tables ship in lib/default/opiate/, so 0 (norot) requires the user to supply matching cooling tables and an sps_path pointing at a norot SPS file; the default SPS fallback rejects SB99_rotation=0. NOTE: name retained for stability. May rename to sps_rotation in a future PR once the cooling subsystem stops being SB99-flavored.

name: sps_refmass
desc: Reference mass for feedback scaling (f_mass = mCluster / sps_refmass). def_value copies SB99_mass; override only for a custom SPS file at a different reference mass.
sourceComment: Reference cluster mass used in f_mass = mCluster / sps_refmass.

name: FB_mColdWindFrac
desc: Fraction of cold material swept up by protostellar winds.
sourceComment: Fraction of cold mass entrained in stellar winds (increases Mdot_wind, reduces velocity).

name: FB_mColdSNFrac
desc: Fraction of cold ejecta from supernovae.
sourceComment: Fraction of cold mass entrained in supernova ejecta (increases Mdot_SN, reduces velocity).

name: FB_thermCoeffWind
desc: Thermalization efficiency for stellar wind kinetic energy.
sourceComment: Defines the thermalization efficiency for colliding stellar winds.

name: FB_thermCoeffSN
desc: Thermalization efficiency for supernova ejecta.
sourceComment: Defines the thermalization efficiency for supernova ejecta.

name: FB_vSN
desc: Supernova ejecta velocity.
sourceComment: Specifies the velocity of supernova ejecta.

name: sps_path
desc: Full path to an SPS data file. def_path (default) uses the bundled Starburst99 grid; any other path enables user mode, which needs sps_col_* column declarations.
sourceComment: Full path to an SPS data file. If def_path (default), TRINITY uses

name: sps_col_t
desc: Time column in a user-supplied SPS table, declared as `index units log|linear`. Required whenever sps_path is set.

name: sps_col_Qi
desc: Ionising-photon-rate column. Required whenever sps_path is set.

name: sps_col_fi
desc: Ionising luminosity fraction column. Required whenever sps_path is set.

name: sps_col_Lbol
desc: Bolometric luminosity column. Required whenever sps_path is set.

name: sps_col_Lmech_W
desc: Wind mechanical luminosity column. Required whenever sps_path is set.

name: sps_col_pdot_W
desc: Wind momentum-rate column. Required whenever sps_path is set.

name: sps_col_Lmech_total
desc: Total mechanical luminosity column. Optional — derived from Lmech_W + Lmech_SN when absent.

name: sps_col_Lmech_SN
desc: Supernova mechanical luminosity column. Optional — derived from Lmech_total − Lmech_W when absent.

name: sps_col_pdot_SN
desc: Supernova momentum-rate column. Optional — derived from Mdot_SN × v_SN when absent.

name: sps_col_Mdot_SN
desc: Supernova mass-loss-rate column. Optional — derived from 2·Lmech_SN / v_SN² when absent.

name: sps_col_v_SN
desc: Supernova ejecta velocity column. Optional — falls back to the FB_vSN constant when absent.

name: sps_col_Li
desc: Ionising luminosity column. Optional — derived from Lbol × fi when absent.

name: sps_col_Ln
desc: Non-ionising luminosity column. Optional — derived from Lbol × (1 − fi) when absent.

name: path_cooling_CIE
desc: Cooling curve for CIE (T > 10^5.5 K). Presets: 1=CLOUDY HII, 2=CLOUDY+grains, 3=Gnat & Ferland 2012, 4=Sutherland & Dopita 0.15Z.
notes: The integer preset is a shorthand; supplying a path string instead loads a user-provided CIE cooling table.
sourceComment: Selects the CIE (T > 10^5.5 K) cooling curve.

name: path_cooling_nonCIE
desc: Path to non-CIE cooling curves (T < 10^5.5 K).
sourceComment: Folder containing the non-CIE (T < 10^5.5 K) OPIATE/CLOUDY cubes.

name: mu_atom
desc: Mean molecular weight of neutral atomic gas (HI + He). μ = 14/11.
sourceComment: Mean mass per particle for neutral atomic gas (HI + He) = mu_H/(1+x_He). Derived at load from x_He (default 14/11 at x_He=0.1). In units of m_H.

name: mu_ion
desc: Mean molecular weight of fully ionized gas (H+ + He++). μ = 14/23.
sourceComment: Mean mass per particle for the HOT bubble interior (fully ionised H+ + He2+) = mu_H/(2+x_He*(1+Z_He)). Derived at load from x_He, Z_He (default 14/23 at x_He=0.1, Z_He=2). The ~1e4 K ionised shell uses mu_ion_shell (singly-ionised He) instead. In units of m_H.

name: mu_mol
desc: Mean molecular weight of molecular gas (H2 + He). μ = 14/6.
sourceComment: Mean mass per particle for molecular gas (H2 + He) = mu_H/(0.5+x_He). Derived at load from x_He (default 14/6 at x_He=0.1). In units of m_H.

name: mu_convert
desc: Mass density conversion factor (n to ρ).
sourceComment: Mass per hydrogen nucleus mu_H = (1+4*x_He) (=1.4 at x_He=0.1), in units of m_H. Use for the n_H -> rho mass conversion (rho = mu_convert * n_H); independent of ionisation state. Derived at load from x_He. All densities n in TRINITY are hydrogen-nuclei densities n_H.

name: x_He
desc: Helium-to-hydrogen number ratio, n_He/n_H. The mean molecular weights are derived from this and Z_He.
sourceComment: Helium-to-hydrogen number ratio n_He/n_H. Composition source of truth: mu_atom, mu_ion, mu_mol, mu_convert and chi_e are all derived from x_He and Z_He at load (read_param Step 6).

name: Z_He
desc: Helium ionisation state inside the hot bubble; 2 = doubly ionised.
sourceComment: Helium ionisation state in the HOT bubble interior (T~1e6-1e7 K): 2 = doubly ionised (He2+). Sets mu_ion and the bubble electron factor chi_e = 1 + Z_He*x_He.

name: Z_He_shell
desc: Helium ionisation state in the ~10⁴ K ionised shell; 1 = singly ionised.
sourceComment: Helium ionisation state in the ~1e4 K ionised shell / HII region: 1 = singly ionised (He+). Sets mu_ion_shell and chi_e_shell = 1 + Z_He_shell*x_He. (He2+ needs ~1e5 K, so the photoionised shell is singly ionised.)

name: TShell_neu
desc: Neutral shell temperature.
sourceComment: Temperature of the neutral shell region.

name: TShell_ion
desc: Ionized shell temperature.
sourceComment: Temperature of the ionised shell region.

name: dust_sigma
desc: Dust cross-section at solar metallicity.
sourceComment: Dust cross-section at solar metallicity.

name: dust_noZ
desc: Metallicity below which dust is negligible.
sourceComment: Metallicity below which there is effectively no dust

name: dust_KappaIR
desc: Rosseland mean dust opacity κ_IR.
sourceComment: The Rosseland mean dust opacity kappa_IR.

name: caseB_alpha
desc: Case B recombination coefficient.
sourceComment: The case B recombination coefficient

name: gamma_adia
desc: Adiabatic index.
sourceComment: the adiabatic index

name: C_thermal
desc: Thermal conduction coefficient.
sourceComment: The thermal conduction coefficient C

name: c_light
desc: Speed of light.
sourceComment: speed of light

name: G
desc: Gravitational constant.
sourceComment: Gravitational constant

name: k_B
desc: Boltzmann constant.
sourceComment: Boltzmann constant

name: PISM
desc: ISM pressure P/k_B.
sourceComment: ISM Pressure, P/k

name: phaseSwitch_LlossLgain
desc: Threshold for (L_gain − L_loss) / L_gain to trigger phase transition.
sourceComment: When (Lgain-Lloss)/Lgain approaches this value, begin momentum-driving phase.

name: transition_trigger
desc: Which criteria end the energy-driven phase, comma-separated; the first to fire wins. Options: cooling_balance, blowout, ebpeak.
sourceComment: Energy->momentum transition criteria, COMMA-SEPARATED (fires on whichever occurs first). Tokens: 'cooling_balance' (default = current behavior), 'blowout' (R2>rCloud), 'ebpeak' (net energy Edot_from_balance<=0); 'r1' aliases 'blowout,ebpeak'. e.g. 'cooling_balance,blowout'. Non-default sets DRIVE the R1 transition (docs/dev/transition/pt4/R1_SHADOW_PLAN.md).

name: cooling_boost_mode
desc: Opt-in boost to unresolved interface cooling: none, multiplier, or theta_target. Experimental; the default leaves cooling unchanged.
sourceComment: Opt-in unresolved-interface-cooling boost (Paper-II note, docs/dev/transition/pdv-trigger/PLAN.md). 'none' (default) = resolved cooling unchanged, BYTE-IDENTICAL. 'multiplier' = Lleak + cooling_boost_fmix*Lcool. 'theta_target' = max(Lcool+Lleak, cooling_boost_theta*Lmech) (tops up to a target loss fraction, single-count). The boosted loss feeds the beta-delta residual, the energy ODE, AND the transition trigger consistently. Never a (1-theta)*Lmech input rescale on top of Lcool -- that double-counts. FALLBACK: 'multiplier' is superseded for L21b *calibration* by cooling_boost_fA (docs/dev/transition/pdv-trigger/FA_STATE_COUPLED.md); retained as a supported opt-in mechanism and bench control arm.

name: cooling_boost_fmix
desc: Multiplier on the resolved cooling integral when cooling_boost_mode is multiplier. 1.0 applies no boost.
sourceComment: Multiplier on the resolved cooling integral when cooling_boost_mode=multiplier (f_mix >= 1). Default 1.0 = no boost. FALLBACK: superseded for L21b *calibration* by cooling_boost_fA (docs/dev/transition/pdv-trigger/FA_STATE_COUPLED.md); retained pending a state-coupled successor.

name: cooling_boost_theta
desc: Target loss fraction L_loss/L_mech when cooling_boost_mode is theta_target. 0 disables it.
sourceComment: Target loss fraction theta = Lloss/Lmech when cooling_boost_mode=theta_target (0..1, with a ceiling theta_max<1 at GMC-core density). Default 0.0 = off.

name: cooling_boost_kappa
desc: Multiplier on the Spitzer conduction coefficient in the bubble-structure solve. Experimental; 1.0 leaves it unchanged.
sourceComment: Rung-A probe (docs/dev/transition/pdv-trigger/KAPPA_EFF_SCOPING.md): multiplier f_kappa on the Spitzer conduction coefficient C_thermal in the bubble-structure solve (f_kappa >= 1). Inflates conduction-zone cooling THROUGH the structure (theta emerges as an output), unlike the scalar cooling_boost on Lcool. Default 1.0 = byte-identical. NOTE it RAISES the evaporative mass flux, which MATCHES El-Badry+19 Eq 47 (mdot ~ C^(2/7), C=6e-7 cgs = C_thermal): measured 1.2175 vs analytic 2^(2/7)=1.2190 at f_kappa=2. [CORRECTED 2026-07-29, FINDINGS 23: an earlier note here called that the "wrong El-Badry sign" -- it is not; Eq 47 rises with conduction. the OTHER factor of Eq 47, (1-theta)^(37/35)/theta^(2/7), falls with theta and is the channel cooling_boost_fA moves.] It remains a structural probe rather than the final model for independent reasons: no whole-band f_kappa exists (FINDINGS 12) and a scalar on Spitzer C cannot represent cool-layer mixing, where kappa_mix/kappa_Spitzer ~ 1e3-1e7 (FINDINGS 9b). Set to 'auto' to resolve at load time to the measured f_kappa that fires the cooling_balance trigger for this (mCloud, sfe, nCore), from the 819-run sweep grid (trinity/_input/fkappa_auto.py; docs/dev/transition/pdv-trigger/data/fkappa_nH_sweep.csv). The 'auto' grid was measured at cooling_boost_fA=1; combining with f_A!=1 silently invalidates the lookup.

name: cooling_boost_fA
desc: Multiplier on the interface radiative source term below 10^5.5 K in the bubble-structure solve. Experimental; 1.0 leaves it unchanged.
sourceComment: Interface source-term boost f_A (docs/dev/transition/pdv-trigger/SOURCE_TERM_DESIGN.md): multiplies the net radiative dudt inside the bubble-structure ODE and the resolved L2+L3 loss integrals, in the interface band T < 10^5.5 K -- the bubble-side conduction front (zones L2+L3) draped on the contact discontinuity at R2, NOT the interface surface itself. The dudt gate is strictly T < 10^5.5 K; the L2+L3 component scaling is unconditional (a degenerate no-conduction-zone slice can scale a sliver above-band -- FINDINGS.md 15j). The 1-D projection of fractal-interface mixing (Lancaster) on the SOURCE side: cooling rises THROUGH the structure and evaporation dMdt FALLS -- the theta-channel of El-Badry Eq 47, (1-theta)^(37/35)/theta^(2/7). [CORRECTED 2026-07-29, FINDINGS 23: cooling_boost_kappa raising dMdt is NOT a contrasting "wrong sign" -- it moves the other factor of Eq 47, (C/6e-7 cgs)^(2/7), which rises with conduction by construction. Both knobs move Eq 47 correctly, in different variables.] L_leak is deliberately NOT scaled (leakage is bulk escape, not interface radiation). Requires f_A > 0; values < 1 are untested suppression territory. Default 1.0 = byte-identical. Single-knob use intended: combining with cooling_boost_mode != none or cooling_boost_kappa != 1 warns at load (double-boost / cross-knob).

name: phase1a_segFrac
desc: Length of each phase-1a integration segment as a fraction of the bubble age. Set to 0 for a fixed 30-year segment.
sourceComment: Phase-1a integration segments as a fraction of the bubble age: dt_segment = phase1a_segFrac*(t_now-tSF). The driving terms (bubble structure, shell, P_HII) are frozen per segment, so this holds their staleness at a constant fraction of the expansion time at every object scale. Set to 0 to fall back to the fixed 30-yr SEGMENT_DURATION, which is a small step for a GMC but spans the entire free-streaming->Weaver relaxation of a compact HII region (docs/dev/phase1a-init/FINDINGS.md). Must be in [0, 1]: negative values would hit the same <=0 fallback as 0 and silently run stock segments, and above 1 a single frozen segment spans more than the bubble's whole age. Converged at the 0.03-0.3 measured range (0.1 -> 0.03 moves R2 at the compact-probe observed age by 0.11%).

name: cool_alpha
desc: Cooling parameter α = v_2 · t_now / R_2.
sourceComment: Cooling related values. alpha = v2*t_now/R2

name: cool_beta
desc: Cooling parameter β = −dP_b/dt.
sourceComment: Cooling related values. beta = - dPb/dt.

name: cool_delta
desc: Cooling parameter δ = dT/dt.
sourceComment: Cooling related values. delta = dT/dt.

name: bubble_xi_Tb
desc: Relative radius ξ = r/R_2 for measuring bubble temperature.
sourceComment: The relative radius xi = r/R2, at which we measure the bubble temperature.
